children: Bancorp investors are fretting that Chime's plans to acquire Stride Bank could spell a major headwind. Chime indicated that it ultimately expects to consolidate its banking activities at Stride, representing a direct risk for Bancorp given its been a key Chime banking partner for years, alongside Stride, Raymond James analysts say in a note. Still, the analysts say the market appears to be overlooking protections included in Chime and Bancorp's contract, as well as opportunities to mitigate some of the pressure or replace Chime with other partners, or more broadly diversify Bancorp's fintech franchise, they say. Bancorp shares slide 20% to $51.60. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
